title: These 3 Ethereum metrics favor an ETH price rally to $6K
summary: Ethereum signalled a potential rally to $6,000 as bullish technicals, tightening supply, and rising institutional demand are starting to look like major tailwinds.

title: PUSD stablecoin deploys on ADI Chain, targeting $3T Islamic finance market
summary: The Shariah-compliant stablecoin backed by Gulf currencies expands to a new Layer-2 network aimed at institutional settlement in the Middle East.

title: Bitcoin weekly close in focus after BTC price fails to revisit $80K
summary: Bitcoin brought its bull market support band as a key level for BTC price action to reclaim during the weekly candle close.

title: Spain seizes crypto cold wallets in illegal manga piracy raid
summary: Spanish police seized crypto cold wallets tied to an alleged illegal manga site, as questions remain over whether officers can access the funds.

title: FTX estate misses out on $3B Cursor stake value after $200K sale in 2023
summary: The FTX estate sold its Cursor stake for $200K in 2023, now worth $3B after a SpaceX-linked valuation surge, raising questions about bankruptcy asset sales.

title: OKX accelerates US push with BitGo off-exchange settlement
summary: OKX integrates BitGo off-exchange settlement for US institutions, reducing pre-funding requirements and marking a key step in its US expansion following ICE investment.

title: Kelp DAO exploiter launders nearly all 75,700 in stolen ETH through THORchain
summary: The wallet linked to the Kelp DAO exploit appears to have laundered most of the $175 million worth of stolen Ether, while another $71 million remains frozen by Arbitrum’s security council.

title: Andre Cronje’s Flying Tulip adds withdrawal circuit breaker as DeFi exploits mount
summary: Flying Tulip said its withdrawal safeguard is designed to fail open, while a status page lets users monitor the system in real time.

title: BlackRock drives 7-day Bitcoin ETF inflow streak as BTC nears $80,000
summary: US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a seven-day inflow streak totaling $1.9 billion, surpassing their March run over a similar period.

title: MetaMask co-founder Dan Finlay leaves Consensys after 10 years
summary: MetaMask co-founder Dan Finlay is stepping down from ConsenSys citing burnout, as long-time crypto figures such as Bitcoin advocate Preston Pysh also pull back from public roles.
